lines.text: Every Friday night ends the same way: digging through Slack threads and Git commits just to bill your client.
InvoiceSnap turns a week of messy work log exports into a clean, line-item invoice in twelve seconds.
Pick your repo and date range, verify every billed hour, and send a Stripe payment link in one click.
Stop donating two unpaid hours every month to formatting spreadsheets.
Try InvoiceSnap on your last sprint free in thirty seconds.
